WITH scan_site_join AS (
  SELECT 
    st.riskeval,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
      THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin
      ELSE NULL
    END AS throughput
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
),
group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    riskeval,
    AVG(throughput) AS group_avg
  FROM scan_site_join
  GROUP BY riskeval
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM group_avgs
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.group_avg,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM group_avgs ga
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ga.group_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg) AS avg_of_group_averages,
  AVG(group_avg - overall_avg) AS avg_of_differences
FROM pairs
